title: Book: Stocks to Riches — Parag Parikh (2017)

text: Parag Parikh's book looks at investing through behavioural finance, using the Indian market. Its themes: investors are driven by fear and greed, which push markets through cycles; understanding your own biases (overconfidence, herd behaviour, loss aversion, anchoring) is as important as analysing companies; and a patient, value-oriented approach with a long horizon tends to work better than chasing hot stocks. It discusses Indian market episodes and encourages investors to think about the long term and emotional discipline. Caveats: it is written from a stock-investing perspective; treat it as education on behaviour, not a recommendation of any fund or stock.
